You can update your contact and account details from your account settings.
Website:
Log in to your account
Go to Account (or your name) > Profile to edit your name, email, and phone number, then Save
Go to Address Book to add/edit delivery and billing addresses and set a default
Go to Payment methods to update or remove saved cards
Go to Communication preferences to manage marketing emails and notifications
Go to Security/Password to change your password
App:
Open the app > Account tab > Profile/Settings, then edit the same details and Save
